questions.q: Two moles of an ideal gas is expanded isothermally and reversibly from 1 litre to 10 litre at 300 K. The enthalpy change (in kJ) for the process is
questions.solution:
$\Delta H = \Delta\left(E + PV\right) = \Delta E + \Delta\left(\text{RT}\right) = \Delta E + R\Delta T$

For isothermal expansion of ideal gas, $\Delta E = 0$

\left(\Delta E = {C}_{v}\Delta T\right)$

So $\Delta H = 0 + 0 = 0 \left(\Delta T = 0\right)$

putting $\Delta E = {C}_{v}\Delta T, \Delta H = {C}_{v}\Delta T + R\Delta T = \left({C}_{v} +R\$right)\Delta$T = ${C}_{p}\Delta$T$ for 1 mole

for n moles, \Delta$H = $\text{nCp}\Delta$T = 0$
